title: MOTION (RAMAN - NAZARIAN) relative to funding for the purpose of installing security fencing to protect the Colfax Avenue Bridge and other improvements.
text:
[Council File 26-0011-S25; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RAMAN - NAZARIAN) relative to funding for the purpose of installing security fencing to protect the Colfax Avenue Bridge and other improvements.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $38,000 from the Council District 4 portion of the Street Furniture Revenue Fund No. 43D/50 to the Bureau of Street Services Fund No. 100/86 in the amounts specified for the purpose of installing security fencing to protect the Colfax Avenue Bridge and other improvements:
• Account No. 001090 (Overtime General) - $30,400 • Account No. 003030 (Construction Expense) - $3,800 • Account No. 003040 (Contractual Services) - $1,900 • Account No. 006020 (Operating Supplies) - $1,900
2. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Services to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
